newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Pepsi eyes Lithuania investment - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi eyes Lithuania investment - newspaper.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc is planning to move into the Baltic state of Lithuania via an investment in a local soft drinks maker, business newspaper Verslo Zinios said on Friday.

A local representative of the company was not available to comment on the report which cited "sources" as saying that Pepsi was set to invest in the Utena brewery, which has a six to seven percent share of the Lithuanian soft drinks market.
The newspaper quoted Pepsi Lithuania director-general Thomas Kucinskas as saying "everything will be clear in two weeks time".
No figures were given for the possible investment.
Lithuania has gained a reputation as a hard place to do business in and lags its Baltic neighbours Latvia and Lithuania in attracting investment.
Its largest investment to date is a tobacco plant in the port city of Klaipeda by Phillip Morris.
